svg.title: Half-frame pair: how it works

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Half-frame pair

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two neighbouring frames on one piece of half-frame film. The film is the canvas; each hole takes a frame as a layer.

svg.text: The pair: one canvas, one export

svg.text: The canvas fits the piece, never a photo:

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: adding, replacing or moving a picture

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cannot resize anything. The picture moves

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under its hole; the hole never moves.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An empty hole is unexposed film: it prints

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: as the base does, near-black (engine render).

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It never exports: both holes must be filled.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame: only that hole's picture changes.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: + Overscan: the same change also lands on the

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Film layer's Overscan, which prints the gap.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the Film layer shows the sum.
